$comment: PostgreSQL clusters that test scripts must never write to, identified by sha256('dinequora-cluster:' + system_identifier) so the raw identifiers stay out of the repository and the logs. A protected cluster can never be claimed or adopted as disposable; persistent operations on it (scripts/ops/db-ops.sh) need a confirmation bound to its identity. Add a cluster here BEFORE it holds data that matters. Hosted (remote) databases are refused by the guard without being listed.
